  - ❌ **Not created on June 3** — it was created **May 20, 2026** (by Maya Chen). June 3, 2026 is when Priya Nair **modified** it.

The other two folders in the workspace (Marketing Assets, HR Policies) aren't in the Legal Hold collection at all, so they don't qualify either.

It looks like the June 3 date is the *last-modified* date rather than the creation date for Vendor Contracts Archive. Want me to add the `archive-ready` tag to it anyway? I held off since the conditions as stated don't line up.
